samples.title: Floor register: Proof strip
samples.statement:
The cabinet supervisor collects one total for every floor of a binary folder tree. Pia rolls a fresh proof strip into the office typewriter. The supervisor wants the readings in their precise working order before signing the file.

Produce the sum of node values at each depth of the binary tree, starting with depth 0 at the root. Missing children contribute nothing.

Return the entire derived sequence, preserving its order.

Implement floorRegisterProofStrip(root, k). k is part of the common inspection-card signature and does not affect this task's result.

samples.title: Floor register: Peak ticket
samples.statement:
The cabinet supervisor collects one total for every floor of a binary folder tree. Mina is setting the upper stop on an old office gauge. The largest derived reading goes on its label, even if the whole tray is below zero.

Produce the sum of node values at each depth of the binary tree, starting with depth 0 at the root. Missing children contribute nothing.

Return the largest value in the derived sequence, or 0 for an empty sequence. Negative maxima must remain negative.

Implement floorRegisterPeakTicket(root, k). k is part of the common inspection-card signature and does not affect this task's result.

samples.title: Floor register: Boss receipt
samples.statement:
The cabinet supervisor collects one total for every floor of a binary folder tree. Alma adds numbered weights to the final receipt at the unit's inspection desk. The first derived reading has weight one, so its position matters as much as its value.

Produce the sum of node values at each depth of the binary tree, starting with depth 0 at the root. Missing children contribute nothing.

Return the weighted sum of the derived sequence: multiply its first value by 1, its second by 2, and so on, then add the products. Return 0 for an empty sequence.

Implement floorRegisterBossReceipt(root, k). k is part of the common inspection-card signature and does not affect this task's result.
